DECLARATION OF ZONINGLOT DEVELOPMENT THIS DECLARATION OF ZONING LOT DEVELOPMENT made as of this 21 day of June, 2016 (this “Declaration") by ST. BARNABAS HOSPITAL, a New York not-for-profit corporation having an office at 4422 Third Avenue, Bronx, New York 10457 (the “Declarant"). RECITALS: A. Declarant is the fee owner of the parcel of real estate and the improvements thereon designated as Lot 34 ("Parcel A") in Block 3051 on the Tax Map of The City of New York for Bronx County, New York (the “Tax Map"), described in Exhibit A annexed hereto, and which is adjacent to Parcel B. B. Declarant is the fee owner of the parcel of real estate and the improvements thereon designated as Lot 45 ("Parcel B") in Block 3051 on the Tax Map described in Exhibit B annexed hereto, and which is adjacent to Parcel A, C. Declarant or its successor intends to construct a new building or buildings on Parcel A and to construct other iniprovements associated with such new building or buildings (said new building or buildings and improvements, together with any future replacements thereof or additions thereto not prohibited by the provisions of this Declaration, hereinafter referred to collectively as the “New Building"). D. Parcel A and Parcel B comprise a single “zoning lot,” as such term is defined in Section 12-10 of the Zoning Resolution (such single zoning lot, as the same may be enlarged or otherwise modified from time to time, being herein called the “Combined Zoning Lot"). E. The parties hereto intend, pursuant to this Declaration, to: (i) provide for the related grants of easements and restrictive covenants as more particularly set forth herein, (i) set forth the portion of the Development Rights appurtenant to the Combined Zoning Lot (                otherwise establish,and set forth,certain rights and obligations of the parties hereto.
